comparison.objective: Remove and replace a server coin cell in a sprung latched socket; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires latch depression, lifting a thin cell, polarity-aware tilted insertion and snap latching. Candidate requires hex-key unlocking, fine collar tuning, relocking and repeated impact trials.
comparison.success_condition: Record tests disposal, polarity, socket centering and latch closure. Candidate tests energy/velocity, 12 mm stroke, hard-stop avoidance and setting retention; several response thresholds are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate retention mechanisms, but the record tests component replacement and snap insertion rather than parameter tuning under dynamic feedback.
